Name: Run In The Bath House (Spa)
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
This mod is pretty simple and automatically sets your speed to the default running speed when you change into your bathing suit so you can power walk around the bath house. You can even swim really fast in the pool too!

(Due to complexity, you don't get the option to walk when you're in your bathing suit.)

Source available on [b][url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/RunningInTheBathHouse]Github[/url]﻿.[/b]
